metadata.title: Master Seed Blueprint Geometry and Snapping Test Cases
metadata.author: Task 1 Independent Geometry Oracle
metadata.description: Exhaustive verification test suite for 1664 Overworld and 832 Nether sliding geometry, safe intervals, centroid weighting, and snapping.

tests.description: Center block (0,0) with center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: Exact center is contained in both conventions.

tests.description: West border block X = Cx - 832 with center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: West border is inclusive in half-open [Cx-832, Cx+832).

tests.description: East border block X = Cx + 832 with center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: East border is EXCLUDED in half-open [Cx-832, Cx+832) because X < Cx+832 is false. Included in closed.

tests.description: North border block Z = Cz - 832 with center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: North border is inclusive in half-open.

tests.description: South border block Z = Cz + 832 with center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: South border is EXCLUDED in half-open because Z < Cz+832 is false. Included in closed.

tests.description: Block just inside East border: X = Cx + 831
tests.mathematical_notes: 831 < 832 is true; block 831 is the easternmost block in half-open window.

tests.description: Block just inside South border: Z = Cz + 831
tests.mathematical_notes: 831 < 832 is true; block 831 is the southernmost block in half-open window.

tests.description: Block just outside West border: X = Cx - 833
tests.mathematical_notes: Excluded in both conventions.

tests.description: Block just outside North border: Z = Cz - 833
tests.mathematical_notes: Excluded in both conventions.

tests.description: Northwest corner block (Cx - 832, Cz - 832)
tests.mathematical_notes: Both coordinate boundaries are inclusive.

tests.description: Southeast corner block (Cx + 832, Cz + 832)
tests.mathematical_notes: Both coordinate boundaries are exclusive in half-open.

tests.description: Negative center at macro envelope limit (-1168, -1168)
tests.mathematical_notes: West/North borders reach exact macro envelope boundary -2000.

tests.description: Positive center at macro limit (1168, 1168), testing point at 2000
tests.mathematical_notes: East/South borders reach 2000, which is excluded under half-open [336, 2000).

tests.description: Nether center at (0,0) from Overworld center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: Exact Nether center is contained in both.

tests.description: Nether West border Xn = -416 with Overworld center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: West border -416 is inclusive in half-open [-416, 416).

tests.description: Nether East border Xn = 416 with Overworld center (0,0)
tests.mathematical_notes: East border 416 is EXCLUDED in half-open [-416, 416). Included in closed.

tests.description: Nether block just inside East border Xn = 415
tests.mathematical_notes: Block 415 is the easternmost block in Nether window.

tests.description: Overworld center at 1168 -> Nether center 146; East border at 562
tests.mathematical_notes: Point 562 is at Nether preflight envelope radius, excluded in half-open.

tests.description: Non-multiple-of-8 Overworld center (4, 4) -> Nether center (0.5, 0.5)
tests.mathematical_notes: Center is 0.5. Window is [-415.5, 416.5). Point -416 is < -415.5, so EXCLUDED in both!

tests.description: Non-multiple-of-8 Overworld center (4, 4) -> Nether center (0.5, 0.5) testing point 416
tests.mathematical_notes: 416 < 416.5 is TRUE! Point 416 is now INCLUDED because center shifted east by 0.5 blocks.

tests.description: Overworld center (-4, -4) -> Nether center (-0.5, -0.5) testing point -416
tests.mathematical_notes: Center is -0.5. Window is [-416.5, 415.5). Point -416 is >= -416.5, so INCLUDED!

tests.description: Safe interval for Overworld structure at X = 0
tests.mathematical_notes: Blueprint claims [-832, 832], but in half-open, C = -832 excludes X = 0. True min is -831.

tests.description: Safe interval for Overworld structure at X = -500
tests.mathematical_notes: Lower bound exceeds macro envelope [-1168, 1168]; clamping yields [-1168, 332].

tests.description: Safe interval for Nether structure at Xn = 0
tests.mathematical_notes: Blueprint claims [-3328, 3328]. In half-open, C = -3328 leaves Xn=0 on excluded border.

tests.description: Safe interval for Nether structure at Xn = 100
tests.mathematical_notes: Scaled coordinate is 800. Center interval spans [800 - 3327, 800 + 3328].

tests.description: Joint safe zone for two Overworld structures at X = -800 and X = 800
tests.mathematical_notes: Structure at -800 requires C <= 32; structure at +800 requires C >= -31 (half-open).

tests.description: Incompatible structures at X = -900 and X = 900
tests.mathematical_notes: Distance between structures is 1800 > 1664. No center can contain both.

tests.description: Standard multi-structure centroid using blueprint capped weights
Exact irreducible rational centroid
Verify weights for all 11 blueprint structure types
tests.mathematical_notes: Total weight must sum exactly to 3+2+2+2+1+1+1+1+1+1+1 = 16.

tests.description: Centroid is already exact multiple of 16
tests.mathematical_notes: No rounding needed.

tests.description: Rounding tie in positive space at val = 8
tests.mathematical_notes: 16 * floor((8+8)/16) = 16. Equidistant from 0 and 16, rounds up.

tests.description: Rounding tie in negative space at val = -8
tests.mathematical_notes: 16 * floor((-8+8)/16) = 0. Equidistant from -16 and 0, rounds up towards +inf.

tests.description: Rounding tie in negative space at val = -24
tests.mathematical_notes: 16 * floor((-24+8)/16) = -16. Equidistant from -32 and -16, rounds up.

tests.description: Interval [18, 30] contains no multiple of 16, fallback to 8 finds 24
tests.mathematical_notes: Multiples of 16 (0, 16, 32) are all outside [18, 30]. Multiple of 8 is 24.

tests.description: Centroid = 18 in [17, 35]: naive formula gives 16 (outside), but 32 is valid
tests.mathematical_notes: Naive blueprint formula 16*floor((18+8)/16)=16 produces a FALSE REJECT even though 32 is in [17, 35].

tests.description: Tight interval [91, 95] contains neither multiple of 16 nor 8
tests.mathematical_notes: Width is 5. Multiples of 8 are 88 and 96. Snapping to either would violate safe interval.

tests.description: Structure at X = 847 requires C >= 16. If centroid is clamped to 15, unconstrained snap to 0 loses structure
tests.mathematical_notes: If algorithm forces unconstrained snapping to 0, upper bound is 832 < 847, losing the structure.
